messages:
owen: Quick heads-up: scheduling a narrow cutover 23:45 UTC to pin runtime v2.8.3 and api v2.2.0. Console is a flag flip only. Need a router handshake sanity check for the new batching header permutation before we freeze pins. @maya @router-team can you run a fast staging pass? deploy-bot will do a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run queued in 15m. Freeze will apply 8m before window. /deploy preflight: no DB migrations.

maya: Ran a staged smoke. Router showed short bursts of 502s when runtime switched to the compact batching kernel under load. Snippet: `2026-03-23T22:03:11Z ERROR router.proxy: upstream 502 - header-permutation mismatch; expected [meta,flags,seq] got [flags,meta,seq]`

router-team: Parser is strict in prod. We can ship a short-lived tolerant shim (router.batch_permute_accept=true) and canary to one shard. No client changes required.

owen: Rollback sequence: if 5xx >0.7% sustained for 4m -> rollback runtime to v2.8.2 immediately. If errors continue, enable router shim and re-evaluate; if still failing, rollback api to v2.1.x. Execution order: runtime -> router shim -> api. @sre-oncall please set alerts to those thresholds and own paging.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll create alert: 5xx >0.7% for 4m -> notify #incidents and page PD. Attaching runbook steps for quick runtime rollback and router-shim flip.

console-eng: We'll add a transient banner and create a console probe that asserts header ordering every 30s. If shim is enabled, we'll include `router.batch_permute_accept=true` in the release notes and UI banner.

router-team: Canarying shim to shard-7 now (1/1). Watching p95, 5xx, and KV tail latencies; will report in ~6m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete; canary started (1/1). Full rollout estimated 18m after green.

maya: Canary stable so far. Slight p95 uptick (~27ms) on KV hot keys but no user 5xx. If p95 >240ms for 3m mark for rollback.

owen: Locking pin window 23:45-00:05 UTC. No other pins allowed during that interval. Draft release note: "runtime v2.8.3 - batching kernel reorder & perf; api v2.2.0 - relaxed header parsing; router - optional permuted-header shim (auto-expire 45m)."

router-team: Shim set to auto-expire 45m after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata `#permute-shim`.

sre-oncall: Pager on standby. I'll escalate per alert rules.

owen: Thx team. Keep status updates to this thread. If we cross thresholds, we'll follow the rollback order and notify support/SEs.
